scenes.title: Preschooler mannequin lifting the wooden mallet toward the 3-foot weighted Bobo doll behind a one-way nursery mirror
scenes.era: 1961, Stanford University Nursery School playroom, California

layout.description: Bright sunlit 1961 nursery playroom with linoleum flooring, a child-sized wooden art table in the corner, a weighted inflatable clown-patterned Bobo rebound doll standing upright in the center, a small wooden peg-board mallet, and a wide one-way observation mirror along the wall.

positions.who: Preschooler mannequin (child-proportioned matte-white mannequin in 1961 striped polo shirt and shorts)
positions.where: standing beside the weighted Bobo doll raising a small wooden mallet in the exact posture demonstrated ten minutes earlier

positions.who: Two blind raters & Albert Bandura (mannequins in 1961 collared shirts and blazers)
positions.where: visible through the adjacent observation booth behind the one-way glass holding 5-second interval clipboards

props.name: weighted inflatable Bobo rebound doll
props.period_detail: 3-foot vinyl weighted-base clown figure with painted smile that rocks backward and pops upright again
props.physical_behavior: tilts back sharply under the wooden mallet tap and rebounds upright

props.name: wooden nursery peg mallet
props.period_detail: smooth light-wood child's toy mallet borrowed from the peg-board table
props.physical_behavior: lifted by the child in direct imitation of the adult model's script

props.name: peaceful Tinkertoy set in corner
props.period_detail: wooden spool-and-rod building kit sitting untouched on the side rug
props.physical_behavior: ignored in the aggressive-model group while favored in the calm-model group

actions.verb_sequence: walks past the Tinkertoy rug straight to the weighted Bobo doll -> pushes the doll sideways -> taps its painted nose with the wooden mallet in exact sequence
check off imitative motor and verbal boxes every five seconds on their clipboards

reactions.reaction: rocks smoothly back to upright equilibrium inviting the next imitated move
points to the clipboard tally showing double the aggressive acts with zero external reward

scenes.wardrobe: 1961 California preschool attire: striped cotton polo shirt, pleated shorts, canvas sneakers; researchers in crisp early-1960s collared shirts, narrow ties, and sport coats.
scenes.lighting: High-key California morning daylight filling the nursery playroom.
scenes.recognition_hook: Ten minutes after watching an adult strike an inflatable Bobo doll, a preschooler picks up the exact same wooden mallet and reenacts every move without a single reward.

key_visual.description: a 1961 preschooler mannequin in a sunny nursery playroom raising a wooden toy mallet toward a weighted inflatable Bobo rebound doll while researchers score behind a one-way glass window

scenes.title: Adult model demonstrating the 10-minute Bobo script vs calm Tinkertoys

layout.description: Nursery room with a child seated at a small potato-stamp art table in one corner watching an adult mannequin interact with either a 5-foot Bobo doll or wooden Tinkertoys.

positions.where: kneeling beside the 5-foot Bobo doll with the wooden mallet
seated at the corner art table watching every move wide-eyed

props.name: 5-foot Bobo doll and potato-print table
props.period_detail: tall weighted vinyl doll and corner craft table
props.physical_behavior: holds the child's rapt visual attention for ten minutes

actions.verb_sequence: strikes the 5-foot doll with the mallet and tosses it upward while the child watches silently

reactions.reaction: stops stamping paper shapes and memorizes the entire physical sequence

scenes.wardrobe: 1961 slacks and collared shirt on adult; polo and shorts on child.
scenes.recognition_hook: Seated quietly at an art table, the child absorbs ten minutes of adult choreography without a word of instruction.

scenes.title: Calm Tinkertoy model drops aggression below control baseline

layout.description: Same test playroom where a child from the Tinkertoy group sits peacefully assembling wooden spools right past the untouched Bobo doll.

positions.where: sitting cross-legged connecting wooden Tinkertoy rods peacefully

props.name: wooden Tinkertoy Ferris wheel
props.period_detail: neatly assembled spool-and-stick structure beside an untouched Bobo doll

actions.verb_sequence: glances once at the Bobo doll -> turns calmly back to building wooden spools

reactions.reaction: logs aggression scores lower than children who saw no adult at all

scenes.recognition_hook: Watching a quiet adult build Tinkertoys lowered aggression below the no-model control group.

scenes.title: Parent modeling calm breathing during a spilled-cup kitchen accident

layout.description: Sunlit modern kitchen island where water spills from a cup; the parent calmly grabs a towel and the young child immediately grabs a second napkin to help.

positions.where: kneeling calmly wiping spilled water with a dish towel
copying the calm posture and placing a second towel down

props.name: tipped plastic cup and cotton dish towels

actions.verb_sequence: exhales slowly and wipes the counter -> child mirrors the exact calm motion

reactions.reaction: nods proudly having learned composure by sight

scenes.recognition_hook: Calm under pressure is absorbed through the eyes just as fast as anger.
